title: betterlite deviation log
description: Where one task's code deliberately differs from the pinned LiteLLM, kept in docs/deviations/<task id>.yaml. The worker writes it, the dispatcher checks its shape and the reviewer reads it.

kept_bugs.description: LiteLLM bugs the task copies on purpose because a working setup relies on them: what LiteLLM gets wrong, why a setup relies on it, and the https link to the LiteLLM line.

link.description: https link to LiteLLM's behavior, or an empty string.
